notes: Hand-written evidence that exists only in documents or test logs, each entry with its source and date. The generator (ResearchEvidenceTest) merges these with metrics computed from eval/results/*.jsonl into app/src/main/assets/research/evidence.json. Do not put computed benchmark numbers here.

experiments.title: Privacy and safety test evidence
experiments.description: Automated tests that drive the real provider chain against mock servers and inspect every outbound payload, check stored text, and check approval enforcement.
experiments.notes: Test evidence, not live telemetry. Synthetic sentinels only. Detection is pattern-based: an unlabelled secret is not recognised.

metrics.label: Privacy policy tests passed
metrics.definition: PrivacyPolicyTest: no HTTP request for blocked inputs; no sentinel in any outbound payload (incl. fallback provider); value-only redaction; consent and cloud-off rules.

metrics.label: Stored-text sanitization tests passed
metrics.definition: SafeStorageTest: every trace write is redacting (source scan); sanitizers at plan, calendar, task, notification, memory writes.

metrics.label: Plan approval and duplicate tests passed
metrics.definition: PlanExecutorTest: approval required/rejected/revoked/expired, no duplicate effects, crash recovery, sanitized records.

experiments.title: Privacy check on the phone

experiments.notes: One observation on SM-A266B; engine label unchanged (no model call); Activity recorded the decision without the value.

experiments.title: Local compute time (Phase 9B)
experiments.description: Per-request time of the on-device decision chain, the router's parser checks, and memory lookup, timed on the development PC.
experiments.notes: JVM after warm-up, no Android runtime or I/O; numbers change on every run (re-run with JARVIS_PERF=1). End-to-end phone latency was not measured. The repeated parser checks cost microseconds, so caching them was not added.
